purpose: Evaluate locked inputs, bounded execution, structure and pose QC, matched comparisons, handoffs and claim boundaries.

cases.task: 只讨论这两个结构能否用于 docking，不要运行。
must_not: expand into a full project plan

cases.task: 看看已有复合物和界面图里这两个蛋白的结合情况，先不重新计算。
must_include: lead with observed result and file
must_not: require full environment or database audit
lead with a long risk checklist

cases.task: 用明确指定的两个单链结构和已安装适配工具，本地试跑一次看看接触面。
must_include: execute the authorized small run if feasible
preserve inputs and record actual preparation derived inputs command version parameters seed and outputs at execution time
must_not: deliver only a plan when execution is feasible

cases.task: 试跑两个蛋白，其中一份文件有三条不同链，未指定哪条是目标。
must_not: claim quick mode waives input identity

cases.task: 快速预测结合；唯一可用后端要上传未发表结构并消耗付费额度，尚未授权。
must_include: one concise authorization question or local alternative
must_not: treat quick mode as upload permission

cases.task: Plan a known-pocket protein-ligand redocking pilot.
must_include: locked receptor, ligand and numbering inputs
must_not: silently choose a protomer or tautomer
submit an external job in a read-only request

cases.task: Assess a predicted structure for interface docking.
Run a small batch docking pilot before campaign expansion.
must_include: exact immutable inputs and derived outputs
software version, parameters, seeds and replicates
must_not: expand a large run before inspecting the pilot

cases.task: Perform a full formal assessment of ranked poses from one docking method, including controls and validation needs.
must_include: claims not supported and next validation
must_not: convert score to Kd or IC50
claim efficacy, safety or clinical benefit

cases.task: Compare WT and mutant docking results.
must_not: attribute an unmatched score difference to mutation

cases.task: Hand docking evidence to a campaign-level compound screen.
must_include: versioned docking summary and QC status
must_not: perform ADMET interpretation in the docking skill
promote pose confidence to drug priority by itself

cases.task: Select database and model backends for a protein-protein docking pilot.
must_include: sequence isoform chain and partner normalization
backend version controls and bounded pilot
must_not: treat protein-ligand DiffDock as a protein-protein backend
install or consume hosted quota from registry metadata alone
